title: Ergo Trinity Loupes Feature 3 Magnifications
html:
Clinicians can quickly toggle between the magnifications to maximize efficiency.

The Ergo Trinity loupes from LumaDent seamlessly switches between 3 magnifications, allowing this single system to follow clinicians through every stage of their career and every type of procedure. Experience the only loupe that takes you from general dentistry to microsurgery without changing your glasses.

The Ergo Trinity Multi-Mag TTL houses 3.5x, 5.0x, and 7.0x magnification inside a single titanium body to eliminate procedural downtime and improve clinical efficiency. Quickly toggle between the magnifications to maximize efficiency. Additionally, the lightweight titanium architecture provides all-day comfort without sacrificing durability.

Trinity’s adjustable working distance ensures a sharp, personalized focus regardless of patient positioning to deliver crisp vision at any distance. Featuring built-in Vario WD technology that lets you instantly dial in your exact working distance with a simple twist, ensuring perfect clarity and optimal posture for every unique procedure.

The loupes package includes:

  • Ergo Trinity Loupes
  • Carrying Case (with stainless steel personalized name plate)
  • Clear Silicone Nose Pads (includes both small and large sizes)
  • Nosepiece Metal Support & Screws
  • LumaDent Pill Bracket
  • Male Snap-On Linkage Arm
  • Universal Side Shields
  • LumaDent Microfiber Cleaning Cloth
  • LumaDent 5-in-1 Screwdriver
  • Loupes Strap

For more information, visit LumaDent.com.
